subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Cameras can reveal lives that avoid human eyes.”?
options: Because of this, Daniel became more careful.
After careful cleaning and covering, it became a park.
The classroom became quiet again, but the students missed the bird a little.
The students became more careful on forest trails.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Because of this, Daniel became more careful.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After careful cleaning and covering, it became a park.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The classroom became quiet again, but the students missed the bird a little.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Cameras can reveal lives that avoid human eyes. The students became more careful on forest trails.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Cameras can reveal lives that avoid human eyes. The students became more careful on forest trails.」，答案為「The students became more careful on forest trails.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The students became more careful on forest trails.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
